title: When a tool is returned needing repair, take it out of lending
statement: Whenever a tool is returned with the condition `needs_repair`, report damage on it, with the return note as the damage note (or "Returned needing repair." when there is none). A return recorded as `good` invokes nothing, so it never clears damage (TL-LEND-INV02). The reaction follows the return's commit, in its own transaction, and is never lost: Tool returned is delivered by outbox, so if the reaction fails, the return still stands and the reaction is tried again.
